purpose: Authenticate every container in the frozen260-phage cohort plus separate catalogue T3 target candidate; inventory existing DNA and deposited CDS translations only.

parse_policy.nucleotides: Uppercase existing source DNA; strict IUPAC DNA; preserve record boundaries and ambiguities.
parse_policy.proteins: Uppercase deposited CDS translation qualifiers only; preserve X, all source letters and stop characters; report nonstandard letters/internal stops. No gene calling, retranslating or missing-annotation filling.
parse_policy.protein_annotation_errors: Preserve errors and suppress incomplete protein FASTA; independently authenticated valid source DNA remains available.
parse_policy.nucleotide_ids: c{sorted_container_index:03d}r{record_index:03d}; disjoint from separately defined t000/t001 reference IDs
parse_policy.contig_sequence_hash: SHA256 domain TipCraft-contig-sequences-v1\0; source record order;8-byte big-endian sequence byte length+uppercase ASCII perrecord; headers excluded
parse_policy.translation_agreement_with_DNA: not_verified; source translation/location/transl_table/exception provenance retained without claiming agreement

failure_policy.changed_cached_payload: error; do not overwrite or redownload
failure_policy.failed_fetch: record error without exclusion or retry
failure_policy.raw_container_publication: atomic after declared size and Git blob SHA1 verification
